meta.name: referrals
meta.description: When the user wants to create, optimize, or analyze a referral program, affiliate program, or word-of-mouth strategy. Also use when the user mentions 'referral,' 'affiliate,' 'ambassador,' 'word of mouth,' 'viral loop,' 'refer a friend,' 'partner program,' 'referral incentive,' 'how to get referrals,' 'customers referring customers,' or 'affiliate payout.' Use this whenever someone wants existing users or partners to bring in new customers. For launch-specific virality, see launch.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 设计并优化老带新推荐计划,让客户持续帮你拉新
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果创业初期想靠老客户口碑带来新用户
copy.tagline_en: Create referral programs that turn customers into new signups
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want existing customers to bring in new ones through referral rewards

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会以推荐营销专家身份协助你设计或优化推荐、分销、口碑类项目。它会先读产品营销背景文件并询问项目类型、现状、产品匹配度等,再给出推荐机制、奖励结构、衡量指标、上线清单和邮件模板等具体产出。
howto.when: 当你说要创建、优化或分析推荐项目、分销项目或口碑策略,或提到“referral”“affiliate”“word of mouth”等关键词,想让现有用户或合作伙伴带来新客户时触发。

say.text: 帮我设计一个双面奖励的客户推荐计划,B2C 产品用。
say.note: Claude 会按推荐循环逐步给出设计方案。

say.text: 现在推荐率很低,帮我分析原因并给出优化建议。
say.note: Claude 会从触发时机、分享流程、奖励设置等角度排查。

say.text: 写一封推荐计划上线的邮件,发给现有客户。
say.note: Claude 会按技能里的邮件模板生成文案。

howto.what_en: Claude acts as a referral marketing expert. It reads product-marketing context, asks about program type/state/product fit/resources, then outputs advice on viral mechanisms, incentives, metrics, launch checklist, emails, and affiliate programs.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user wants to create, optimize, or analyze a referral, affiliate, or word-of-mouth program, or mentions keywords like 'referral,' 'affiliate,' 'word of mouth,' or wants existing users/partners to bring in new customers.

say_en.text: Design a double-sided referral program for a B2C product.
say_en.note: Claude walks through the referral loop step by step.

say_en.text: Our referral rate is low. Analyze why and suggest improvements.
say_en.note: Claude investigates timing, sharing flow, and rewards.

say_en.text: Write a launch email for our referral program to existing customers.
say_en.note: Claude uses the skill's email template.
